        self.assertEqual(core.transpose([[1,2],[3,4]]), [[1,3],[2,4]])

        from desk import calendar_month_shift as core
        from desk import calendar_month_shift_api as api
        self.assertEqual(api.reschedule_due_items([api.DueItem("a",date(2025,1,15))],1), [api.DueItem("a",date(2025,2,15))])

    def test_export_line_endings(self):
        from desk import export_line_endings as core
        from desk import export_line_endings_api as api
        self.assertEqual(api.export_notes(["a","b"]), "a\nb\n")

    def test_label_ellipsis(self):
        from desk import label_ellipsis as core
        self.assertEqual(core.truncate_label("abc",3), "abc")
